text:
Maya: Heads-up: Skyline Cloud marketplace listing + joint integration demo webinar confirmed for May 26. Need launch checklist, inbound lead routing, co-branded assets, and a short benchmark narrative for the blog. Who takes what?
Jon: I can own lead routing + tagging. thinking: add partner_source=skyline and campaign_code=SKY-LAUNCH-0526 to every link. then use Segment -> Marketo -> SFDC mapping.
Priya: Webinar ops: run-of-show draft: 15m partner product overview, 20m live demo (integration), 10m Q&A. We need speaker bios + 3 demo scripts. Can we get a 5-min intro case study slide?
Sam: For attribution, prefer real-time webhook to partner with signed DPA, but fallback nightly SFTP fine. Partner asked for a daily CSV + a copy to S3. encryption: PGP.
Ava: Messaging note for assets: emphasize "production-ready inference" and "predictable cost at scale". Benchmark angle: show 2 scenarios: (1) single-VM low-latency baseline, (2) Redwood+Skyline optimized throughput with KV caching. highlight latency and $/1000 tokens.
Maya: Good. Keep benchmark narrative concise: methodology (same prompt set, 30s warmup, median latencies), hardware notes, and reproducible script link. Priya: can you draft the methodology blurb?
Priya: will do. Also need CTAs for landing page: 
- Try integration (1-click sandbox)
- Request a POC
- Register for webinar (adds participants to joint nurture)
Which should be primary?
Jon: Primary = Register for webinar (ads drive sign-ups). Secondary = Try integration for devs. POC reserved for high-intent enterprise leads captured by a field `enterprise: true`.
Sam: Lead CSV spec (partner nightly drop) sample header I propose:
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,country,role,product_interest,partner_source,campaign_code,marketo_contact_id,consent_shared_with_partner,notes
```
Maya: Nice. Add `region` as well and `lead_score` so partner can triage.
Sam: updated.
Ava: On the benchmark, include a tiny table screenshot in the blog showing median latency, p50/p95, and cost per 1k tokens. I'll mock it in Figma.
Priya: Webinar landing page fields: email, company, role, region, primary_use_case (dropdown), share_with_partner (checkbox). Legal approved default unchecked.
Maya: Routing matrix (quick):
- share_with_partner=true & product_interest contains "integration" -> Partner queue (real-time if DPA signed else nightly).
- lead_score >= 70 or enterprise=true -> Redwood AE immediate handoff + notify partner.
- all others -> co-branded nurture (7-email cadence).
Jon: I'll create Marketo smart lists and the webhook for partner. ETA 5/2.
Priya: I'll drop run-of-show + speaker slides by 5/10. Also propose a pre-webinar dry run with partner on 5/20.
Ava: For blog headline options: 
A) "Integrate LLM inference into product flows — Redwood + Skyline"
B) "Reduce inference cost and latency for product teams with Redwood & Skyline"
I prefer B for SEO.
Maya: B works. Sam: can you prepare the CSV schema and a mapping doc for partner fields? put in https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/skyline-launch.
Sam: Done. uploaded `skyline-nightly-sample.csv` and added PGP public key. jen-bot: Reminder: "Skyline Launch - Marketing Review" scheduled 5/12 9:00am PT. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/skyline-launch-review
Maya: Final asks: Jon - UTMs + Marketo flows (5/2), Priya - landing + run-of-show (5/10), Sam - partner CSV + keys (5/3), Ava - benchmark visuals + blog draft (5/14). I'll assemble a combined checklist and share with partner. Thanks team :rocket:
